concept.title: Housing advice and support
concept.shortdesc: Advice about housing and hands-on help to find, keep or receive accommodation.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Advice, guidance and information about housing issues, rights, options and tenancy applications.
: Receiving housing or accommodation itself, or hands-on help to find a home and keep a tenancy, especially for people who are homeless or need support.
